_comment: Measured values printed by the T.5.4 report figures. One entry per figure.
Each carries the decision-register entry that recorded it, so a figure can be
traced back without opening the plotting code. Editing a number here changes
the figure and nothing else; the scripts hold no numbers of their own.

bound_interval.source: docs/docs_decisions.md D56 (PROJECT_STATE_v6 section 2 mislabels this row as Q=3)
bound_interval.instance: Q = 2, T = 22, minute recourse, single-threaded, p_minutes = 56

valuation_decomposition.source: docs/docs_decisions.md D78 (2026-09-02), scripts/minute_vs_slot_schedule.py --policy start --p-minutes 56, both solves proven optimal
valuation_decomposition.instance: baseline, Q = 2, T = 22, 30-minute slots, p_minutes = 56, policy = start

midpoint_counterfactual.note: Superseded by D76 (the committed departure offset is now policy=start; midpoint is a labelled counterfactual per R2). Kept, not deleted, because the report's superseded-values table (8_Deliver section 4.8) refers to these numbers.
midpoint_counterfactual.instance: baseline, Q = 2, T = 22, 30-minute slots, p_minutes = 56, policy = midpoint

multiresolution_gain.instance: Q = 2, p_minutes = 56, de-aligned generated shapes, every solve proven optimal
